verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents its own Optimize task for compressing PNG and JPG files and a thumbnail task that outputs PNG, JPG or WEBP. Together these show some first-party compression and size handling for common image formats. The custom ImageMagick/GraphicsMagick command task is a developer building block rather than documented quality controls, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented image conversion covering HEIC and SVG, explicit quality/size/compression parameters on image conversions, WebP compression control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
